⚠️PLEASE READ⚠️
Amazonian Survival is currently in EARLY ACCESS. By purchasing the game now, you are supporting its development and getting the chance to play it before the full release. Since the game is still in early development, you will run into bugs, experience incomplete features, and possibly have performance issues. Many mechanics and visuals are work in progress and will continue to be improved over time!

- Amazonian Survival is in early access, please expect bugs during this period.
- Want to appeal a punishment? Join our community!
